title: Equiangular lines in dimensions 18 to 20
text: Equiangular lines in dimensions 18 to 20: Valjakas Djaljapayan, Zhen-Qi Liao and Wei-Hsuan Yu, working with GPT-6, show the maximum number of equiangular lines in dimensions 18, 19 and 20 is exactly 57, 72 and 90. The best published upper bounds had been 59, 74 and 94.
